name: text_to_image
description: Use when the user needs a new still image from a text description. Do not use for editing an existing image; use image_to_image instead. Returns a generated image.

size.description: Allowed values: 1K, 2K, 3K. Or use explicit WIDTHxHEIGHT dimensions.

response_format.description: One of: url, b64_json. Allowed values: url, b64_json.

name: image_to_image
description: Use when the user supplied or referenced an existing image and wants it edited, restyled, or varied while preserving visual context. Returns a new image.

size.description: Allowed values: 1K, 2K, 3K. Or use explicit WIDTHxHEIGHT dimensions.

response_format.description: One of: url, b64_json. Allowed values: url, b64_json.

name: list_seedream_models
description: Use only when model selection or model availability is relevant; it does not generate media. Prefer the configured default for ordinary image requests.
